scan_cache_dir: scan the HuggingFace cache directory and return an HFCacheInfo structure with repo details
delete_revisions: delete cached revisions by commit hash and return a DeleteCacheStrategy for dry-run or execution
export_as_table: export HFCacheInfo as a formatted table showing repo, revision, size, and access information
execute_delete_strategy: execute a DeleteCacheStrategy to remove cached blobs, refs, snapshots, and repos from disk
scan_cached_repo: scan a single HuggingFace cached repo path and return a CachedRepoInfo with revisions and file details
